purpose: Artifact-level provenance and licensing policy for science curriculum, retrieval, evaluation, and model-training candidates.
disclaimer: This ledger is an engineering control, not legal advice. Re-verify every artifact and its license at ingestion time.

rules: A source being public, free to read, or open access does not make it training-compatible.
Licenses attach to exact artifacts and versions, not to a domain name or repository host.
Code, prose, media, data, and metadata from one project may have different licenses and must be sharded separately.
Share-alike material must remain in an isolated, clearly licensed configuration and cannot be silently mixed into a permissive release.
Noncommercial or no-derivatives material is not admitted to a commercial model-training corpus.
Raw human-subject neural data is excluded from language-model training even when legally public; use only in an approved, privacy-reviewed evaluation or scientific-analysis pipeline.
Every admitted artifact must have a stable identifier, version or commit, retrieval time, SHA-256, license evidence URL, attribution text, and transformation log.
Discovery metadata never grants rights to the linked full text.

sources.name: Mathlib for Lean 4
sources.license_scope: repository source files; retain file-level notices and verify vendored assets separately
excluded_uses: unattributed republication
claiming generated text is a kernel-checked proof
sources.attribution: Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and record the upstream commit and declaration path.

sources.name: Physlib: the Lean Physics Library
sources.license_scope: repository source files; verify vendored assets separately
excluded_uses: treating formalized assumptions as empirical confirmation
sources.attribution: Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and cite the upstream commit and declaration path.

sources.name: CERN Open Data Portal
sources.automated_access: record APIs and artifact URLs published by CERN
sources.license_scope: portal metadata and datasets; software, documents, and other content retain their separately stated licenses
excluded_uses: ingesting portal software or documents without their artifact license
implying CERN endorsement
sources.attribution: Cite each dataset DOI and acknowledge the named experiment even where CC0 applies.

sources.name: Qiskit core SDK
sources.automated_access: git clone or signed release archive
sources.license_scope: Qiskit core repository code; documentation content is governed separately
excluded_uses: assuming IBM Quantum website prose shares the code license
submitting jobs to paid hardware without explicit approval
sources.attribution: Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and the upstream version or commit.

sources.name: Qiskit documentation content
sources.license_scope: prose, guides, tutorials, courses, media, and non-code assets; code snippets and scripts are Apache-2.0 and must be separated
excluded_uses: mixing prose into a permissively licensed dataset
dropping share-alike attribution
sources.attribution: Carry CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution and indicate transformations; isolate Apache-2.0 code snippets.

sources.name: OpenFermion
sources.license_scope: repository content subject to file-level notices and vendored-dependency review
excluded_uses: executing external chemistry backends without separate license and environment review
sources.attribution: Preserve LICENSE and NOTICE and cite the OpenFermion release paper where appropriate.

sources.name: OpenNeuro published datasets
sources.automated_access: OpenNeuro CLI, GraphQL API, S3, or versioned git/DataLad endpoints
sources.license_scope: newly published dataset snapshots; older artifacts must still be checked for their snapshot-specific license and acknowledgement metadata
permitted_uses: derived aggregate evaluation with a version DOI
excluded_uses: raw-data language-model training
attempted re-identification
unversioned draft ingestion
clinical decision-making
sources.attribution: Cite the version DOI and honor HowToAcknowledge even when CC0 does not legally require attribution.

sources.name: DANDI Archive
sources.license_scope: each Dandiset has its own declared CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 license
permitted_uses: derived aggregate evaluation after artifact license review
excluded_uses: raw human-data language-model training
ingestion without Dandiset license metadata
attempted re-identification
clinical decision-making
sources.attribution: Cite the versioned Dandiset DOI and follow CC-BY attribution where applicable.

sources.name: Brain Imaging Data Structure specification
sources.license_scope: BIDS specification repository; tools in other repositories have separate licenses
excluded_uses: treating schema conformance as scientific validity or participant consent
sources.attribution: Provide BIDS attribution, version, file path, and transformation notes.

sources.name: PubMed Central Open Access Subset
sources.automated_access: PMC Cloud, OAI-PMH, FTP, E-Utilities, or BioC only
sources.license_scope: each article and version retains its own license; PMC inclusion alone is not permission for unrestricted reuse
permitted_uses: CC0 and CC-BY-4.0 article ingestion with attribution
excluded_uses: non-OA PMC articles
NC or ND articles in a commercial derivative corpus
scraping PMC HTML outside approved services
medical advice generation
sources.attribution: Store the full citation, PMCID, DOI, article license, license URL, and any publisher notice per record.

sources.name: arXiv metadata
sources.automated_access: arXiv API or OAI-PMH under published API terms
excluded_uses: assuming metadata rights apply to full text
high-rate scraping outside API terms
sources.attribution: Retain arXiv identifier, version, authors, and canonical URL.

sources.name: arXiv article full text
sources.automated_access: S3 bulk access or article endpoints after license filtering
sources.license_scope: each article version has its own license; most default arXiv licenses do not grant third-party redistribution rights
permitted_uses: CC0 and CC-BY-4.0 versions after exact license verification
excluded_uses: default arXiv-license full text in redistributed training data
NC or ND versions in a commercial derivative corpus
license inheritance across versions
sources.attribution: Store exact arXiv version, authors, title, license URI, and transformation log.

sources.name: OpenAlex scholarly metadata
sources.license_scope: OpenAlex data and metadata; linked PDFs retain their original copyright and license
excluded_uses: treating a PDF URL as permission
ingesting full text without its original license
using bronze/free-to-read as an open license
sources.attribution: Retain OpenAlex work ID and original identifiers; cite OpenAlex in research outputs.

sources.name: Crossref metadata
sources.automated_access: Crossref REST API, OAI-PMH, or public data file
sources.license_scope: bibliographic facts and Crossref-generated data; abstracts retain publisher or author copyright
excluded_uses: abstract ingestion without an artifact license
full text ingestion
assuming deposited license URLs are independently verified by Crossref
sources.attribution: Retain DOI and source; use a polite User-Agent and cache responses.

sources.name: Allen Institute site content default terms
sources.automated_access: manual review before any artifact retrieval
sources.license_scope: site content is noncommercial by default unless a specific artifact explicitly states another license
permitted_uses: manual review of an artifact carrying an explicit compatible license
excluded_uses: commercial training corpus ingestion under default terms
assuming all atlas data is CC-BY
bulk copying site content
sources.attribution: Follow the artifact-specific citation policy if an exception is approved.

sources.name: OpenStax University Physics and Calculus
sources.license_scope: current title pages identify noncommercial share-alike terms; some downloadable editions may display different terms, which creates artifact-level ambiguity requiring manual review
excluded_uses: commercial model-training corpus
mixing with permissive dataset shards
assuming one edition license applies to another
sources.attribution: Follow the exact edition's attribution and share-alike terms if used in a separate noncommercial context.

sources.name: NIST/CODATA Fundamental Physical Constants, SRD 121
sources.automated_access: manual reference and citation; no bulk corpus copy without confirming SRD terms
sources.license_scope: NIST Standard Reference Data compilations can be copyright protected; general NIST employee-work permissions do not automatically override SRD-specific terms
excluded_uses: bulk copying the SRD compilation into a redistributed training corpus
discarding uncertainty and version metadata
sources.attribution: Cite SRD 121, the CODATA adjustment version, NIST, and access date.
